# The daggerheart fixtures as a deck

Every card note in this folder — domain cards, ancestries, communities and
subclasses, English and German — on A4 in whichever orientation holds more
cards, cut marks on. The block names only the system: the folder is this
note's own, and the card-type list leaves the order to the system's
declaration.

```cardsmith-deck
system: daggerheart
```
